target_customer: Warhammer hobbyists who buy and sell miniatures, starting with Games Workshop products
problem: General marketplaces misidentify miniatures, have weak filters and are crowded with counterfeits. Miniswap matches listings to a catalogue of more than 20,000 miniatures so buyers can search by attributes.

founders.name: Zak Singh
education: University of Cambridge, computer science PhD (dropped out)
previous_startups: Hear Me, mental health app with over 100k users (CTO)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he has played Warhammer since age six.

founders.name: Will Hanna
education: McGill and Cambridge, advanced degrees in economics and philosophy
founders.background_notes: YC page says he advised CEOs of large companies including Bridgewater Associates and Pfizer. Roommate of Zak at Cambridge.

competitors.name: eBay
competitors.what: General marketplace where most Warhammer resale happens

competitors.name: Facebook Marketplace and groups
competitors.what: Informal local trading used by hobbyists

technical_complexity.rationale: Building and maintaining an AI assisted catalogue of 20,000 plus miniatures with photo based listing creation is moderate engineering; marketplace liquidity is the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: The structured catalogue and listing matches are a data asset and a marketplace gains liquidity, but eBay and Facebook already hold the buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy found; Miniswap added an eBay sync feature, which keeps eBay as a partner channel.

market_need_then: Hobbyists complain about misidentified listings and counterfeits on general marketplaces; the YC launch post reports 1,000 sign-ups and over $40k of listed inventory in four weeks.

branding.domain_note: Uses miniswap.gg, not a .com. A Cardano exchange called Minswap shares a similar name.

identity.logo: A Spikey Bits article mentions a new logo but gives no design detail
identity.voice_and_tone: Hobbyist founders who play Warhammer, community first launch on forums

branding.community_and_virality: Launched via a Dakka Dakka forum thread in 2025-09 and covered repeatedly by the Spikey Bits hobby site, which also published comparisons against eBay.

brand_strength.rationale: Hobby press and forum coverage show early community attention, but the name overlaps with a crypto exchange and no deeper brand evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Miniswap is an active two person YC Fall 2025 company that raised a reported $3.5M seed in December 2025 and has early community traction. The founders are lifelong Warhammer players, which gives domain insight. The outcome depends on building marketplace liquidity against eBay and Facebook; no exit or failure found.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 403 so it was not read. Round confirmed by Tech Funding News (2025-12-16) and Startupmag, which quotes GBP 2.6M; Seedtable dates it 2025-12-16. FundedIQ lists a $500K pre-seed, treated as an outlier. Investors not named in the sources opened. Founder bios come from the YC page.
